fullDescription: Light SaaS pricing section with a teal accent: sticky glass nav, centered heading + monthly/annually toggle, and a 3-tier card row where the middle 'Pro' tier is a scaled-up, solid-teal 'Most popular' card flanked by two white ghost cards.

structured.summary: A clean, light SaaS pricing section ('Lumen — Design at the speed of thought') for an AI design tool, built around a 3-tier card row. A sticky translucent nav sits above a centered heading band (eyebrow pill, big extrabold headline, subhead, and a monthly/annually billing toggle), then three pricing cards where the middle 'Pro' card is the highlighted, scaled-up, teal-filled 'Most popular' tier between two white ghost cards, finished by a money-back guarantee line. Single teal accent on a near-white slate canvas with a faint multi-glow grain wash.

style.description: Bright, modern SaaS pricing aesthetic: a near-white slate canvas (#f8fafc) with a faint multi-point teal radial-glow grain wash, ink (#0f172a) headings, slate (#475569) body text, and teal (#0f766e / #14b8a6) as the single brand accent. White ghost cards (1px slate ring, soft layered shadow, rounded-2xl) flank a solid teal-700 (#0f766e) highlighted card that is scaled up (~1.04) and pulled up (-my-3) with a deep teal pop shadow. Inter typeface throughout (weights 400-900); prices are 5xl extrabold tracking-tight; feature rows use teal check-circle icons with hairline slate dividers. Pill badges and toggle use the teal-50 (#f0fdfa) tint with teal-100 (#ccfbf1) ring.
style.prompt: Build a light SaaS pricing section on a near-white slate background (#f8fafc) with a faint 'grain' wash made of three layered radial gradients (an ellipse 60% 50% at 50% -8% of rgba(13,148,136,0.10) fading to transparent at 60%, a circle at 14% 30% of rgba(15,118,110,0.06) fading at 40%, and a circle at 90% 22% of rgba(20,184,166,0.07) fading at 42%). Use Inter (weights 400-900, antialiased, optimizeLegibility) for everything. Headings are ink #0f172a, extrabold, tracking-tight; body text is slate #475569. Single brand accent is teal: teal-700 #0f766e (primary buttons + the highlighted card fill), teal-800 #115e59 (hover), teal-600 #0d9488 (icons), teal-500 #14b8a6 and teal-200 #99f6e4 / teal-100 #ccfbf1 / teal-50 #f0fdfa for tints and rings, teal-900 #134e4a for the deepest scale step. White ghost cards use rounded-2xl, a 1px slate-200/70 ring, and a 'card' shadow (0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.04), 0 12px 32px -12px rgba(15,23,42,0.12)); the highlighted card uses a solid teal-700 fill with a 'pop' shadow (0 24px 60px -18px rgba(15,118,110,0.55)). Smooth scroll behavior on html.

layout_and_structure.description: Single centered column, max-width ~72rem (max-w-6xl), 1.5rem horizontal padding, generous vertical padding (py-20 / sm:py-24). Vertical order: sticky glass nav -> centered heading band (eyebrow pill + h1 + subhead + billing toggle) -> a 3-up pricing card grid where the middle card is highlighted/scaled/elevated -> a centered guarantee line. Responsive: the card grid is 1 column on mobile (capped at max-w-md and centered), expanding to 3 equal columns at lg; nav center links hide below md and 'Sign in' hides below sm.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top header (sticky top-0 z-50) with a bottom border-slate-200/70 and a translucent backdrop: bg-[#f8fafc]/85 with backdrop-blur-md. Inside, a max-w-6xl row at h-16, items center, space-between. Left: an 8x8 rounded-lg teal-700 (#0f766e) square with a white ph:sparkle-fill icon (18px) + soft shadow, then a 17px extrabold tracking-tight 'Lumen' wordmark. Center: nav links (Product, Library, Pricing, Docs) at 14px medium slate (#475569), hover ink; 'Pricing' is the active link in ink; the whole nav is hidden below md (hidden md:flex). Right: a 'Sign in' text link (semibold slate, hover ink, hidden below sm) plus a solid teal-700 rounded-lg 'Start free' button (white semibold, px-4 py-2, hover teal-800).

A centered text block inside a max-w-6xl, py-20 (sm:py-24) section. Top: an eyebrow pill (inline-flex, rounded-full, bg-teal-50 #f0fdfa, ring-1 ring-teal-100 #ccfbf1, 12px semibold uppercase tracking-wider teal-700 text) with a ph:lightning-fill icon (14px) reading 'Pricing'. Below it: an h1 at 4xl (sm:5xl) extrabold tracking-tight ink reading 'Design at the speed of thought'. Below that: a max-w-xl centered subhead at 16px leading-relaxed slate reading 'Prompt it, ship it. Every plan includes the full prompt library and the infinite canvas. Pick the seats and credits you need.'

A centered inline-flex row (mt-8, gap-3, 14px semibold). Left label 'Monthly' in ink. A pill toggle: a relative h-7 w-12 rounded-full bg-teal-700 (#0f766e) button with a 5x5 white rounded-full knob (absolute left-1 top-1, soft shadow) sitting to one side (annual-active state). Right label 'Annually' in slate, followed by a small rounded badge (bg-teal-50, ring-1 ring-teal-100, 11px teal-700) reading '-20%'.

prompts.partPt: Planos e Preços card grid (ghost + highlighted)
prompts.prompt: A responsive grid (mt-14, mx-auto, max-w-5xl, grid-cols-1, items-center, gap-6; sm capped at max-w-md and centered; lg:max-w-5xl lg:grid-cols-3 lg:gap-5) of three pricing cards. The two outer cards (Starter, Studio) are white rounded-2xl p-8 with shadow-card and a 1px slate-200/70 ring: a centered base-size bold slate tier name, a centered baseline price row (5xl extrabold tracking-tight ink value + '/mo' small slate), a feature list (3 items) where each li is a flex items-center gap-2.5 with a teal-600 ph:check-circle-fill icon (18px) and 14px semibold slate text, separated by hairline slate-100 top/bottom borders (py-3.5), then a full-width 'Get started' button (rounded-xl, bg-teal-50, ring-1 ring-teal-100, teal-700 bold, hover bg-teal-100). The MIDDLE 'Pro' card is the highlight: relative z-10, solid teal-700 (#0f766e) fill, rounded-2xl, p-8, shadow-pop, scaled up at lg (lg:-my-3 lg:scale-[1.04]); a 'Most popular' badge (absolute -top-3, centered, rounded-full bg-white px-3 py-1, 11px bold uppercase tracking-wider teal-700, soft shadow); tier name in teal-100, the '$24' price in white with '/mo' in teal-200, a 4-item feature list with teal-200 check icons and white text divided by white/15 hairlines, and a white 'Start free trial' CTA (rounded-xl bg-white, teal-700 bold, soft shadow, hover bg-teal-50). Cards: Starter $0/mo (120 credits / month, Full prompt library, 1 design canvas); Pro $24/mo (2,000 credits / month, Coding-agent skill access, Unlimited canvases, Priority generation); Studio $79/mo (10,000 credits / month, 5 team seats, Shared brand kits).
A centered paragraph (mt-12, 14px slate) with an inline teal-600 ph:shield-check-fill icon (15px, aligned -2px) reading '14-day money-back guarantee. Cancel anytime, no questions.'

special_ui_components.prompt: Highlighted 'most popular' pricing card: a solid teal-700 (#0f766e) filled rounded-2xl card sitting between two white ghost cards, lifted and scaled (lg:-my-3 lg:scale-[1.04], z-10) with a deep teal 'pop' shadow (0 24px 60px -18px rgba(15,118,110,0.55)) and a white 'Most popular' pill badge absolutely positioned over its top edge.
Billing toggle: a small h-7 w-12 rounded-full teal-700 switch with a white knob and Monthly/Annually labels plus a teal-tinted '-20%' savings badge.
Eyebrow pill: an inline-flex rounded-full teal-50 (#f0fdfa) badge with a teal-100 ring, an icon, and uppercase tracking-wider teal-700 micro-label.

Feature row with hairline dividers: a flex items-center list item with a teal check-circle icon and semibold text, separated by 1px slate-100 (white ghost cards) or white/15 (highlighted card) top/bottom borders.
Multi-glow grain wash: a section background made of three layered radial gradients in teal tints (top-center ellipse + two corner circles) for soft ambient color without heavy shadows.
Glass sticky nav: a sticky top-0 z-50 translucent bg-[#f8fafc]/85 + backdrop-blur-md header with a slate-200/70 bottom hairline.

structured.special_notes: Single-accent discipline: teal (#0f766e primary, #0d9488 icons, #14b8a6/#99f6e4/#ccfbf1/#f0fdfa tints) is the only brand color on a near-white slate (#f8fafc) canvas with ink (#0f172a) headings and slate (#475569) body. The defining move is the contrast between two white, 1px-ring ghost cards (soft 'card' shadow) and a single solid teal-filled, scaled-up, elevated 'Pro' card (deep 'pop' shadow + white CTA + white 'Most popular' badge) so the eye lands on the recommended tier. Depth comes from a faint three-point teal radial-glow grain wash, not heavy shadows. ONE typeface, Inter (weights 400-900) via Google Fonts; prices are 5xl extrabold tracking-tight. Icons are Phosphor (ph:*) via Iconify. Copy is human with zero em-dashes ('Prompt it, ship it.', '14-day money-back guarantee. Cancel anytime, no questions.'). Plan data is sample content so the prompt ships with no bundled assets.
